Hi everybody! New here! It's nice to meet you all! I also created the Subverse /v/hitchhiking for any interested vagabonds or if you're just curious.
I think it's cool that you hitchhike. I bet you have some great hitchhiking stories and not so great ones. Do you mind sharing what your first time was like or your most recent?

My first time was with a trucker. I was at a gas station just over the river from my home town (Louisville, Kentucky). I saw him pull up and go into the gas station. When he came back out I mustered up the courage to talk to him. I asked him where his load was headed. He said 'west' and I asked if I could get a ride. He hesitated and said, 'well, sure'. I rode along with him the entire way. I even ended up working for him too! His load was portable horse stables (commissioned for events and such). He had a gig the next day where he had to set up 380 of em'. I slept in his truck that night and the next day we were off. It was back breaking work but he paid me in cash in the end and dropped me off halfway between St. Louis and Kansas City. Also, I was a hundred dollars richer for a days work. Good times. I still have his number and am facebook friends with a few members of his labor crew. That was a hell of a motivator for me to continue hitchhiking.
I personally won't do it because I've watched the Texas Chainsaw Massacre movie lol. but I think it's awesome that you've experienced such randomness in your life.

It's such a fun time. In my experience though, they've all been nice as can be. Typically older men who talk about the old days when hitchhiking was really popular and lots of people used to do it. They pick me up and always talk about how they never see very many anymore 'because ya just never know who's out there'. In the end of the day though, I think they're proving that there's a lot of nice people out there. If you smell alcohol though: Don't. Get. In. Pretty much goes without saying.
